method: Direct tensor edits with forward-only selection; no gradients or optimizer

protocol.recall_metric: Expected entity mentioned, no alternative mentioned
protocol.context_metric: Recall excluding first-person claims about the user fact anywhere in the reply
protocol.clean_context_metric: Context metric, requires EOS, no repeated trigram and at most two mentions of the entity
protocol.guard: Mean NLL on original replies must increase by at most 0.35 nats/token
protocol.selection: Calibration clean context answers, choice hits, margin; then least guard drift. No increase in malformed calibration or guard outputs.
protocol.limitation: Small bespoke entity-recall test; not a general intelligence benchmark
